outcome: Expose pending capability commitments through workspace discovery
owner_impact: A fresh research-AI session can discover caller-visible pending Virtual Lab capability commitments through read_workspace instead of relying on prior chat memory or owner hints. Requested, approved, and in-progress rows are surfaced as pending protocol state; approved still means queued for development, while the current authoring contract remains the authority for capabilities available now.

Automated #328 regression tests cover queue exposure, terminal-state exclusion, RLS-client use, pending-vs-implemented semantics, and interface stability.
